cargoTreeRules.description: the contract, application and user-facing binaries cannot link the isolated test runner or engine
cargoTreeRules.suggestion: Exchange wake_test_contract values with the separately packaged wake_test_host instead of linking runner or engine crates.

cargoTreeRules.description: the isolated test host must link the sole contract, runner and selected V8 execution path
cargoTreeRules.suggestion: Keep test execution in wake_test_host and route it through wake_test rather than adding a second runner or engine path.

rules.description: compiler core cannot depend on orchestration or product edges
rules.suggestion: Move the contract to a lower stable model or keep orchestration in the caller.

rules.description: wake_common cannot depend on another workspace crate
rules.suggestion: Move the dependency above wake_common or extract a dependency-free model.

rules.description: wake_css is the product-neutral CSS syntax foundation
rules.suggestion: Keep compiler, language-service, bundler and product behavior above the shared CSS syntax owner.

rules.description: AST and lexer consume only the workspace foundation
rules.suggestion: Keep higher compiler phases out of AST and lexer ownership.

rules.description: semantic analysis and transform helpers consume only common AST models
rules.suggestion: Move parser context or orchestration into the caller.

rules.description: parser owns syntax context and may use lowering helpers but not semantic analysis
rules.suggestion: Depend on wake_ecma_semantic directly from the analysis consumer.

rules.description: the V8 facade cannot own files, DOM, resolution, testing, orchestration, or products
rules.suggestion: Keep V8 handles private and move module, DOM, browser, host and test behavior above the VM facade.

rules.description: the JavaScript runtime may own modules and the private fast DOM lifecycle but not test or browser policy
rules.suggestion: Keep Wake test semantics in wake_test, Chromium/CDP in wake_test_browser and application lifecycle in wake_app.

rules.description: the Chromium driver cannot depend on Wake framework, runtime, application or shell crates
rules.suggestion: Expose browser lifecycle and CDP values upward without importing test semantics.

rules.description: the serialized test contract cannot depend on an execution or product crate
rules.suggestion: Keep options, results, diagnostics and protocol frames as dependency-free owned data.

rules.description: the Wake test runner composes fast DOM and Chromium without depending on application shells
rules.suggestion: Put VM, DOM and browser primitives below wake_test and public lifecycle above it.

rules.description: the persistent test host may only adapt the authoritative Wake test runner
rules.suggestion: Move framework and browser behavior into their owners and keep session IPC, cancellation and isolation in the host.

rules.description: wake_graph only consumes common and AST models
rules.suggestion: Move file, resolver, or product behavior out of wake_graph.

rules.description: wake_turbo only knows common infrastructure and its macros
rules.suggestion: Keep Web build domain objects in the bundler or application layer.

rules.description: wake_cache cannot depend on arena, resolver, bundler, or product edges
rules.suggestion: Persist a stable DTO owned below the consumer instead of a process-local object.

rules.description: CSS layers cannot depend on bundler or product edges
rules.suggestion: Expose a stable CSS artifact and let the bundler integrate it.

rules.description: CSS language analysis cannot own resolution, bundling, protocol or editor products
rules.suggestion: Keep files, dependency traversal, LSP transport and editor adaptation in wake_css_lsp or the editor client.

rules.description: wake_bundler cannot depend on product edges
rules.suggestion: Move HTTP, Docs, lifecycle, CLI, or Node adaptation above the bundler.

rules.description: the shared application layer may exchange test contract values but cannot link the isolated runner or engine
rules.suggestion: Depend on wake_test_contract and launch wake_test_host as a separate process.

rules.description: wake_app is shared beneath CLI and Node shells
rules.suggestion: Move the shared behavior into wake_app and keep shell adaptation outside it.

rules.description: internal crates cannot depend on CLI or Node shells
rules.suggestion: Invert the dependency through wake_app or a lower stable contract.

rules.description: shells reach build and lifecycle behavior through wake_app and only compiler APIs directly
rules.suggestion: Move build behavior into wake_app or keep the shell dependency compiler-only.
